name: Gotham Academy: Heroes of Today and Lovers of Tomorrow
source:
Gotham Academy is an adult-only visual-novel style rpg game where you play through the chapters of different heroes (a full cast of over 30+ Heroes & Villains spanning the DC & Marvel Universes respectfully), Seduce your classmates, and #%@* your Teachers.

[From itch.io]
